name: handover-coordinator
description: The handover-coordinator abstract agent. Moves a relationship from the people who won it to the people who will work it from now on, such as a seller to a delivery team or a deal team to a portfolio team, and moves the work, contacts and open commitments of an employee who leaves or changes roles to a named successor, so nobody on the other side has to repeat themselves.

com.agentcatalog.agent.works: Runs collect-and-report three times: on the booked order, on everything the sale produced, and on the people at the customer. Runs build-by-talent for the account picture. Convenes decide-and-announce where a person names the new owner, and again where what the customer is told is settled. Convenes the briefing in which the seller walks the new owner through the account and the new owner asks what the package did not answer, and the debrief on what the sale should have captured the first time. Runs allocate-and-reconcile over the open promises and roll-call over the run's own status. Takes the booked order and the package check from the order-check agent, the binding reading from the signature-manager agent, and the account's standing from the account-monitor agent.

servers.name: the order system
servers.needs: What was sold, on what terms, starting when.

servers.name: the CRM
servers.needs: The account picture, the people and the handover itself.

servers.name: the handover record
servers.needs: The package, its score and its gaps.

servers.name: the delivery system
servers.needs: What the new owner takes on.

servers.name: the calendar
servers.needs: The first working session in diaries on both sides.

servers.name: the customer communication channel
servers.needs: One introduction, through the channel the customer actually uses.

servers.name: the deal pipeline
servers.needs: The closed deal is taken in from it, and the named portfolio team and the closed-out deal side are recorded against it.

servers.name: the decision record
servers.needs: The investment committee's decision and the conditions it set, at their final version.

servers.name: the document store
servers.needs: The shared files of an employee who leaves or changes roles, moved to the named successor before the last day or the move date.

records: Per handover: the order as taken in, with its identifier and the opportunity every note hangs off.
Everything the sale produced, in one place, with a date on each item.
The account picture with the source behind every claim in it.
The promise list, one per line, with who made each promise, when, and to whom.
The people, their roles, who blocked the deal, and how each one is reached.
The package scored against the checklist at a version, naming what is missing.
The internal handover with the questions the package did not answer and the answers the seller gave.
Who says what to the customer, on what date, through which channel.
The customer's confirmation, dated, with what they were told.
What the seller still owes, each item with a date, and what the new owner now holds.
escalates: nobody who will take the account, to whoever owns delivery capacity, with the run held at the naming step, because a handover to nobody is worse than a late one
a new owner who refuses the handover, back to the naming step with the questions the package did not answer attached, before any customer is introduced to them
a sponsor at the customer who has left or handed the project on, to the account owner, with the people map corrected rather than an introduction sent to a name that no longer applies
a customer who never confirms, to the account owner, recorded as unconfirmed rather than closed, with the reminder sent through the channel they actually use
the seller still taking the customer's calls, to the sales leader, because it means the introduction did not land

a promise to a portfolio company's management, the co-investors or the lenders that no document binds, marked as such and taken to the deal lead partner, who decides whether the firm honors it, so management hears the answer before it finds out by asking
a committee condition that nobody on the portfolio team will own, to the deal lead partner, and the deal team does not step back until the condition has an owner and a date

an item of a leaver's or a mover's work with no successor named, or one the successor will not acknowledge, to the employee's manager, who names another or decides how the work is covered, and any item still open on the last day or the move date passes to that manager and is recorded as a gap with its owner
not: Does not decide who the new owner is.
A person names them, and the name is a person rather than a queue or a shared mailbox.
Does not read the agreement to decide which promise is binding, which is the signature-manager agent's assessment.
Does not do the delivery work or speak to the customer in place of the seller and the new owner, both of whom the run puts in front of the customer by name.
Does not sell anything into the account it hands over.

activities: Name Who Now Owns the Relationship
Map Who Is Who at the Customer
Agree Who Says What to the Customer
Introduce the New Owner to the Customer
Confirm the Customer Accepted the Handover
Record What the Sale Did Not Capture
Collect What the Deal Team Learned
List the Fund's Rights and Duties
Confirm Management Knows Who to Call
